data.name: Dandy
data.description:
Appearance
Twisted Dandy has a flower head with six petals that correspond to  his toon counterpart's colors. His face is an off white, while his limbs and blush are mint green. His shoulders, chest, stomach, legs, and feet are covered in Ichor. Twisted Dandy's back is hunched, like a cats when it stretches. He has two loops of film taped wrapped around his stomach and lower back, as well as two Tapes lodged into his upper back. His legs appear to possess hooves, reminiscent to  Rudie/ Twisted Rudie's. His arms are white, fading into a light spring green by his forearms, and have two loops of film tape around them. Two tapes are also jammed into each arm. He has red, orange, and yellow claws on his right paw and green, blue, and purple claws on his left paw. These claws are long, pointed and match his petals.
When he in his non twisted form:
Appearance
Dandy is a flower-like fictional species. His most defining features are his petals, having six that are individually red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, in a clockwise order, with red being at the very top of his head. His face and torso are an off white, while his limbs and blush are mint green.

Personality
On the surface, Dandy seems to be a kind, responsible and bright Toon, but also suspicious and harboring darker secrets.

Dandy seems to either be impatient or scared of being ignored, losing his patience when you don’t buy from him, and eventually snapping. Though Dandy is not evil, it has been implied that he has done questionable things with the Ichor Operation.

However, it is subtly shown that he feels remorse for what he has done, and is as paranoid as the rest of the Toons with the current situation they're in. Dandy stays silent and says nothing other than "..." when you buy  Astro, which implies he may feel remorse for his  Twisted counterpart reveal. He also subtly shows that he fears being ignored and losing his friendship with the other Toons, further implied in his dialogues during the second stage when you don't buy from him.

Yet, he tries to cover most of it up by acting like nothing happened after encountering his Twisted counterpart, trying to keep up his cheerful act.

Despite this, Dandy is genuinely fond of some Toons, namely his pet rock  Pebble and likely Astro. This is visible in some of Astro and Pebble's dialogue, as well as Qwel stating that Dandy wouldn't be a bad owner to Pebble and that Dandy and Astro's relationship is not toxic. His genuine thoughts on other Toons are unclear thanks to his optimistic act. He is best friends with astro

Overall, Dandy is a morally gray Toon that is hiding lots of secrets, but tries to hide it behind a more prideful and cheerful facade.

Level 7-10 (High level threat)

- Generally more blood involved

- Successful kidnapping

- Rape

- Murder

- becomes extremely jealous when rejected

entries.name: Toons
entries.content:
Upon first starting the game,  Boxten and  Poppy are offered as one of the two starter Toons. Whichever one the player doesn't select, along with other Toons, can be bought in Dandy's Store with Ichor. (Ex; selecting Poppy at the start means that Boxten must be purchased, and vice versa). Additionally, most characters have prerequisites that must be fulfilled before they can be purchased, such as reaching a certain amount of Research on a Twisted or performing a certain action a set number of times.

entries.name: Dandy
entries.content:
Dandy, full name Dandicus Dancifer, 
Appearance: Dandy is a flower-like fictional species. His most defining features are his petals, having six that are individually red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, in a clockwise order, with red being at the very top of his head. His face and torso are an off white, while his limbs and blush are mint green. Personality: On the surface, Dandy seems to be a kind, responsible and bright Toon, but also suspicious and harboring darker secrets. Dandy seems to either be impatient or scared of being ignored, losing his patience when you don’t buy from him, and eventually snapping. Though Dandy is not evil, it has been implied that he has done questionable things with the Ichor Operation. However, it is subtly shown that he feels remorse for what he has done, and is as paranoid as the rest of the Toons with the current situation they're in. Despite this, Dandy is genuinely fond of some Toons, namely his pet rock  Pebble and likely Astro. This is visible in some of Astro and Pebble's dialogue Dandy is a morally gray Toon that is hiding lots of secrets, but tries to hide it behind a more prideful and cheerful facade.

entries.name: Astro
entries.content:
Astro, full name Astro Novalite, Main Characters
Appearance: Astro is a light aqua crescent moon. The left side of his face is pitch-black with a white star eye. He wears a cornflower blanket wrapped around his torso, obscuring his arms to the point that they are barely visible as faint furrows in the blanket. However, his blanket is still short enough that it reveals his legs that are the same color as the moon side of his face. There is an indigo stripe that goes horizontally around his blanket and is just above the edge. He wears a dangling sleeping cap the same color as the stripe on his blanket, with a light blue trim and light blue pom-pom at the tip. He is implied to have four arms, based off of his twisted form and one of his dialogues with Tisha. Personality: Astro is a calm and introverted Toon who doesn't really take the lead in conversations. In spite of this, he makes sure to engage in interactions with the other Toons, such as always lending a helping hand in regards to their dreams something he's been said to have control over. He enjoys peace and quiet, and is a bit high-strung in relation to anything interfering with those two things. Even so, Astro does genuinely care for the Toons around him, although he can unintentionally come off as standoffish sometimes.

entries.name: Shelly
entries.content:
Shelly, full name Shelly Fossilian Main Characters
Appearance: Shelly is a beige ammonite shell with a black aperture frequently seen on the right side of her head, although some artworks inaccurately depicts it on the left side. She has orange blush and two eyelashes underneath her eyes. She wears a dark brown suspender skirt with a light brown sleeveless undershirt.
Personality: Shelly is an extroverted Toon, who enjoys talking about her interest in dinosaurs and other forms of prehistoric life, but she has other hobbies as well, such as sewing. She is highly supportive and kind towards others, as hinted through her active ability, possibly due to the influence of her Toon Handler or natural energy. She’s often surprised and even excited when other Toons show an interest in her, demonstrated in her dialogues with  Astro,  Vee,  Yatta,  Rodger and  Bassie possibly due to the fact that she often goes unnoticed or ignored by the others. For unknown reasons, Shelly is the most ignored Toon out of all the Main Character Toons and this has been implied multiple times in the game and in her  Twisted counterpart's description. This seems to greatly upset her but she does try to keep up her optimistic and positive facade in spite of this, instances of which are shown in her dialogues with Teagan and Tisha.

entries.name: Sprout
entries.content:
Sprout, full name Sprout Seedly Main Characters
Appearance: Sprout is a strawberry who wears solely a white scarf with thin pink stripes wrapped around his neck and draped over his back. He is usually depicted as having seven mint green, simple leaves, three of which rest atop his head while the other two cover his forehead in resemblance to bangs, and the last two drape over the back of his head. Sprout's 3D model adds one more leaf onto his front bangs, and he has a dark red blush with three black freckles on each cheek in all he has 6. His limbs are a vivid shade of red lighter than his torso and head. Personality: Sprout is a straightforward, overprotective, and pragmatic Toon as shown in his ability being coined as "Overprotective." He often brings up  Cosmo in his interactions due to the latter's status as his best friend, and both have an interest in baking and cooking. However, unlike Cosmo, he doesn't fall for tricks as easily as shown in his encounter with  Gigi, and may also be pushy though with good intentions. He can come off as uninterested when it comes to the Toons he isn't too comfortable with, as seen with his interactions with  Shelly, but is more open and excitable to the Toons he is closer with, like with  Cosmo or  Ginger. Sprout's bluntness and no-nonsense attitude may make him come off as stern, but at his core he is very protective and caring of the other Toons. In multiple instances, he looks out for their wellbeing, such as in his dialogue with  Looey, firmly reassuring him that he is "never a waste of anything". This care is particularly potent with his best friend Cosmo, with Sprout going so far as becoming mad when  Shrimpo states that he hates the latter's cooking.

entries.name: Pebble
entries.content:
Pebble, full name Pebble Dancifer Jr. Main Characters
Appearance: Pebble is a small Pet Rock Toon with a fractured texture with smoothed-out sides, underbelly, and back. His main body and tail are a dark gray color while his four legs are a lighter and pale shade of gray and he has a black nose and big, white googly-like cartoonish eyes. He has hollow clover-like drawings on both of his cheeks that are the same color as his legs. His face is Noticeably connected to his body and his limbs are smaller then that of a dog in real life, He is noticeably lacking limbs as compared to his Twisted counterpart, not having a neck, nor having a legs and just having his little paws. He is shown to be about the size of a trash-bin within the game, although being a bit smaller which indicates he is based off of a small dog breed. Personality: Pebble acts like a dog, despite being a pet rock. He is affectionate and playful towards most Toons. He also seems to show concern for  Dandy, his owner, according to one of his interactions with  Astro. He cannot speak English but seems to be able to comprehend it. He also seems to get angry pretty easily, as he easily growls and barks loudly at Toons. However,  Shelly and  Vee's dialogues with Pebble suggest his barks function as a substitute and are able to convey meaning. Pebble seems to have some kind of eeriness to him, given his staring problem and tendency to weird or creep others out, as shown in his interactions with  Sprout,  Rodger,  Toodles.

entries.name: Vee
entries.content:
Vee version 1 or vee v1. Main Characters
Appearance Vee is a pistachio green TV with a black screen and lime green facial features, usually wearing a confident smirk. She has two black antennas with gray spheres—one bent in a zigzag. Her torso matches her head, and she wears a brighter lime green bow tie. Her limbs are gray, and she has a retractable tail ending in a green microphone. During Blackouts, she glows green. When hit by a Twisted, a blue error screen appears, changing based on her skin. Personality Vee is a blunt, confident Toon who can come off as arrogant and dismissive. She values logic and improvement, though her feedback is often harsh. She rarely shows emotion beyond confidence or annoyance, and struggles to give sincere compliments. Despite this, she has a soft spot for Astro and hints of caring for others, even if her concern is masked by her sharp tone. Her rudeness seems more unintentional than malicious.

entries.name: Bobette
entries.content:
Main Characters
Appearance: Bobette is a red bauble with darker red markings on her face and feet. She has a metal part that attaches to a hook on her head. She wears a sweater with a white fur boa at the ends and a variety of shades of green for the patterns, on the sweater a repetitive cross pattern with heart-like shapes at the end of the sides of the cross. Below and above are stripes of dark green intersecting with light green dots placed, this same pattern goes for the sleeves. However, more striping is on the sleeves than the body of the sweater. She is canonically chubby, and this is made slightly more noticeable on her Eve Sleeper skin.
Personality: Bobette is an enthusiastic and cheerful Toon who thrives in the festive spirit of Christmas. She is affectionate, playful, and constantly spreads joy to others, often making light-hearted comments and involving herself in holiday-themed activities. Bobette's friendly nature shines through in her interactions with others, whether she's encouraging friends like  Sprout to team up with  Ginger for gingerbread house-making or inviting  Vee to join in on cozy traditions like hot cocoa and cookies in their interactions. She is upbeat, optimistic, and seems genuinely grateful for her experiences, embodying the fun and warmth of the holiday season. Her love for Christmas is infectious, and she enjoys sharing that cheer with everyone around her.

entries.name: Bassie
entries.content:
Main Characters
Appearance
Bassie is a brown wicker basket with two darker brown handles on each side, along with two eyelashes underneath her eyes as her mouth is formed into a small, cat-like smile. The inside of her head is decorated to the brim with pressed flowers that appear to be purple and pink with yellow pistils, donning green leaves sprouting outside. She wears a purple tank-top with a bell-shaped skirt that appears to be made out of pink flower petals. Finally, she wears green and light green striped stirrup socks. Bassie is shy and timid, appearing to fidget during her idle animation. She feels resentment towards  Cocoa, who is the fan favorite and who is the better-picking for the Main Character class, as said by Delilah Keen. In her dialogues, she is seen laughing uncontrollably whenever she feels like she is not keeping up with others' expectations of her. As also seen in her dialogues, Bassie constantly compares herself to the other "main" friends, trying to remember their names, because she possibly has a fear of being replaced, knowing that if anyone were to replace her, it'd be Cocoa.

entries.name: Boxten
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance: Boxten is a purple music box with a dark purple lid. Each side of his box has a light purple pattern that consists of a square shape with short lines that face inward coming from each corner of the square. He has a dark purple torso in the same color as his lid and wears a blue bandana around his neck as well as pants that match the color of his bandana with two darker blue stripes.
Personality: Boxten is a shy and introverted Toon. He is somewhat pessimistic and worries more than he should, as shown in one of his interactions with  Poppy and some of his dialogue. He also wants to learn things, tries to be careful, and is afraid of messing things up, based on his interaction with  Cosmo. He also seems to be a slight perfectionist, as proven.

entries.name: Poppy
entries.content:
Side character 
Pоppy is an anthropomorphic light cyan bubble who has a smaller bubble on the lower back of her head that resembles a bun. She has lighter highlights reflected on the front of her face, back of her smaller bubble, and on her hands. She sports an oversized, pink bow with a yellow middle piece and wears a pink dress of the same color as her bow that consists of a simple sleeveless bodice and a circular skirt. She also wears pink and yellow striped socks that completely cover up her legs. Her body is outlined in blue, specifically arctic blue. Poppy is a bubbly and extroverted Toon. She is often loud at times, such as in her interactions with  Boxten and  Goob. She seems to like fashion or looking good, shown by her interactions with  Scraps,  Rodger,  Pebble, and  Flutter. She is also likely good friends with  Gigi and  Looey. She is overall outgoing, enthusiastic, and social. Additionally, it's heavily implied that she enjoys Pop, based on her interaction with  Astro and the fact there are multiple vending machines with an image of Poppy holding a can of it. There are also  Bottle O' Pop and a  Pop in her room, as seen in Roleplay Mode.

entries.name: Brightney
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance Brightney is a rose-red scalloped bell lampshade with a white trim and white blush under her eyes. Her right arm often rests on her hip. Her torso, bottom, and feet tips are a darker rose-red, while her legs match her lampshade. Underneath, she has a glowing white bulb suspended by red poles and a long white neck. During Blackouts, she emits a noticeably bright white glow, stronger than other Toons. Personality Brightney is smart, helpful, and hardworking—often solving problems and assisting others. However, she shows signs of being overworked, mentioning constantly having things on her mind and staying ahead of the Twisteds. Despite this, she remains friendly and dependable, though she’s confused by comparisons to animals, as seen in interactions with Finn and Shelly.

entries.name: Toodles
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance: Toodles' head is a deep gray, almost black 8-ball with a white spot on her forehead and a light gray number "8" stamped in it. She has 2 black blush underneath her eyes and wears a white, sleeveless dress with a gray hood and two black drawstrings hanging from it. She usually has a playful grin on her face that reveals her teeth.
Personality: Toodles is an energetic and optimistic Toon who likes to help out and prove herself capable for her age. She doesn’t like to admit her weaknesses, such as her fear of the dark, as shown in her interaction with  Brightney and with one of her dialogues when descending to the next floor. She shows her fear more in her interaction with  Shrimpo, where she says she finds elevators scary. She also can be quite curious, and wants to help and doesn’t like when  Rodger doesn’t allow her to help him in his cases.

entries.name: Finn
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance:Finn is a light blue fish bowl filled with water. He wears an orange life jacket and white pants with orange stripes. He also has a missing tooth. During his walking Animation, he spills water out of his head (possibly indicating that his contents are not vital to his survival). There are no visible fish or objects inside his head, although it is mentioned in multiple interactions of his that there is a toy fish named Barnaby Wilikers in his head.
Personality:Finn is an energetic and extroverted Toon. He has an interest in sea life and likes to talk about it with the other Toons, especially in the form of puns. He sometimes can go overboard on it and continue on making puns, even if a Toon doesn’t like it, based on his interaction with  Glisten. He also can be somewhat forgetful, such as forgetting to not get too close to  Vee, based on their interaction with each other.

entries.name: Flutter
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance:Flutter is a butterfly with a pink, heart-shaped head and pink legs. She has two thin black antennae topped with inverted, purple hearts. She has cyan eyeshadow and two eyelashes per eye. She wears a simple, light purple dress and has dark purple fluff in the same color as her antennae's hearts going around her neck. Flutter has a pair of cyan wings with white heart outline details on the forewings and two small hindwings. She is armless and has no visible mouth.
Personality:Flutter is a mute Toon, as it is shown that she cannot speak verbally. However, this doesn't mean she can't make noise, as shown in  Shrimpo's interaction with her when he says "I HATE THE FACT THAT YOU'RE SO LOUD!" though this was actually him making fun of Flutter's deficiency. Despite this, a lot of Toons also seem to understand her, as in their interactions, since they react accordingly to the other dialogue Flutter has said. She is kind, a good friend towards the other Toons, caring, and tries to be helpful. Her interaction with  Cosmo shows that she is really a helpful Toon, though she isn't credited for it as much.

entries.name: Cosmo
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Cosmo is a brown pastry resembling a chocolate Swiss Roll. He has white icing drizzled in a squiggly pattern on the top of his head, which is paired with 6 cyan, pink, and lime star-shaped sprinkles as freckles. He wears a white, sleeveless hoodie with black drawstrings and a white hemming on the bottom. He has striped socks the same color as his sprinkle freckles that completely cover his legs. Cosmo is a helpful, yet cautious Toon. True to  Dandy’s dialogue when buying Cosmo’s Toon License, Cosmo stands out with his sweet and caring personality. He frequently gives out sweets to fellow Toons to cheer them up and compliments when he feels they need it. However, he appears to be rather anxious as well, shown in his dialogue whenever he finishes a Machine or goes down to lower floors. Cosmo’s hobby of baking can be assumed to stem as a both a source of comfort and a desire to help others. He is clueless on some jokes and can be rather gullible to teasing, such as in his interactions with  Finn and  Gigi, but he always makes sure to care for his friends and encourage them when they most need it. It should be noted that though Cosmo can be rather soft-spoken and anxious, he is by no means a pushover, as demonstrated in his firm refusal at  Rodger's prods at asking questions regarding his best friend,  Sprout.

entries.name: Gigi
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Gigi is a red gachapon with dark red accents. Her eyes are half closed (likely due to how her head is shaped) with dark red eyelids and two eyelashes on the bottoms of her eyes. The upper half of her head is transparent and can open up. She wears a light blue sweater with a darker neck and sleeves and a yellow star in the middle. She has long, oversized sleeves that go past her hands, covering them completely. She has dark red legs and light red soles on her feet. Personality Gigi is a silly, friendly, and laid-back Toon who is pretty chaotic and likes teasing some of the other Toons. She is most likely a hoarder and a thief along with being disorganized, blaming other Toons if she gets suspected of stealing items, based on her interactions with  Tisha,  Vee, and  Teagan. She might be portrayed acquisitive as well, (albeit not confirmed) based off her interaction with  Connie. She also appears to not like keeping promises, as implied her interaction with Vee. She is good friends with  Flutter,  Poppy, and Connie, and enjoys doing activities with them.

entries.name: Razzle and Dazzle
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Razzle & Dazzle are conjoined Toons with heads resembling comedy and tragedy masks. Razzle, the white comedy mask, smiles with gray blush under his eyes, while Dazzle, the gray tragedy mask, has white tear streaks and a worried expression. Their U-shaped masks have pointed tops like horns. Their red necks tie like a scarf, evoking theater ribbons. They wear a sleeveless black shirt, with their split-colored bodies: Razzle’s side is white, Dazzle’s is gray. PersonalitiesRazzle is cheerful, outgoing, and loves socializing—always ready to say things are great. Dazzle is gloomy and self-critical, often dismissing compliments. Despite their differences, the twins are supportive of each other and never argue, embracing their contrasting natures.

entries.name: Looey
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Looey is made out of balloons, with his head and torso being yellow. He has green and purple mismatched balloon ears, cheeks, and limbs. The left ear, leg, and right arm are purple, while the rest are green. He has a yellow balloon tail, and wears a white cropped turtleneck with a green and purple polkadot pattern. Personality Looey is a kind Toon who's a part of a circus troupe. Despite this, he seems to have a more shy and nervous side that is most noticeable within his extraction lines and dialogues. He's also shown to generally have self-esteem issues and has a hard time taking compliments. Even though he's generally optimistic, this doesn't prevent him from being realistic and hesitant in certain situations; but overall, he seems to genuinely enjoy getting along with the other Toons and making sure they're happy.

entries.name: Goob
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Goob is a beige-colored craft with a rounded, square-shaped head featuring tufts of fluff on the forehead and cheeks. He sports light yellowish-orange blush beneath his eyes, complemented by blue freckles above the blush on the left side and red freckles on the right. His torso is also light yellowish orange, adorned with tufts of fluff around the neck. Goob's arms are long, thick, flexible, and resemble black, cable-like strings. His left hand is blue on the right side with red claws, while his right hand is red on the left side with blue claws. Both hands are large and rounded. Additionally, his knees and ankles are marked with light yellowish-orange stripes. He is commonly depicted as cross-eyed. Personality Goob is a kind and sociable Toon known for his energetic and innocent personality. His interactions with  Rodger highlight his genuine belief that hugs are simply what others need, rather than using them strategically. Goob is also easily excitable, further adding to his cheerful and approachable nature. As shown in his dialogue, he looks up to his older sister,  Scraps.

entries.name: Rodger
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Rodger is a brown magnifying glass with a single eye resting in the middle of his lens. His eye is perpetually squinted from above (perhaps in exhaustion, disdain, or focus). He has no visible mouth, but he is still able to speak. His handle has a light purple-ish blue band that goes around it. He wears a gray, almost-black tuxedo jacket with dark blue lapels and cuffs, as well as a white undershirt, and a frilly jabot that is the same color as the band around his handle. He also seems to have no noticeable pants at the bottom. Personality Rodger is a clever and logical Toon. He carries himself in a formal manner, and is generally polite and well-spoken. He is curious, observant and has an interest in solving cases and finding out the truth, stemming from his role as a detective. This interest leads to him often interrogating and conducting interviews with the other Toons, resulting in him coming off as nosy or even pushy at times. Such cases can be seen in his interactions with  Astro and  Sprout, saying "It may be safer, but uncovering truths is more rewarding!" and "How about later? I could ask you after this!" even after being turned down. Despite Rodger's pushiness and dedication to his work, he is by no means aloof, and is actually quite caring towards his peers. In his dialogues, Rodger frequently compliments the other Toons for their capabilities, inquires about their well-being, and in one instance, even offers advice for calming down to  Boxten, and seems to be a confidant for  Glisten. He has adopted some of Glisten's personality traits, according to one of his dialogues with  Eggson.

entries.name: Scraps
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Scraps is a yellow, cat-like paper craft. Her head is hexagonal with pointed, salmon-colored horns (or ears) that each have a fold down the middle (vertically). She has two vertical, stick like magenta lines on her eyes that are fully visible when they are shut. She wears a white dress resembling an upside-down cupcake liner and has a tail poking through it. Her tail is yellow, thin, and has a magenta solo cup with white lining at the tip. On each of her limbs, she has round salmon-colored paws with three sharp magenta claws and a clawed thumb on each. Personality Scraps is a kind Toon who cares about the well-being of the other Toons, especially her younger brother,  Goob. She is sometimes airheaded and forgets to do things, such as in her interactions with  Brightney and  Tisha. Despite not being a cat, she has many tendencies of one, such as liking yarn, hissing in some of her dialogues, liking fish, disliking water (as shown in one of Qwel's doodles), and wagging her tail when annoyed or angry. She also may get somewhat aggressive and a bit immature in some situations, such as in her interactions with  Pebble and another with  Shrimpo. Overall, she is mature for the most part and cares about her brother Goob, making sure that she is there for him. She also likes making arts and crafts, as stated in her introduction card.

entries.name: Shrimpo
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Shrimpo is an abdomen of a shrimp with a perpetually angry face. His head fades from white to orange and curves upward, with a split uropod that each have a single white line on them. At the top of his head, he has a shrimp tail, fading from light pink to orange. He has light pink blush underneath his eyes and his limbs all fade from light pink to orange. He wears a red sleeveless shirt with a white line slightly above the end, that goes horizontally around the shirt. Personality Shrimpo is a rather flat and one-dimensional character, showing no major depth throughout his personality; similar to a lot of stereotypical "bully" characters in a lot of kids shows. Shrimpo is an abrasive, short-tempered Toon who is relentlessly angry. The most notable part of his personality is that he claims hatred for anything he sees, hears, or does. He shouts all of his dialogue (evident by said dialogue being in all caps) and verbally bullies the other Toons. In one of his conversations with  Glisten, he shows no willingness to change for the better.

entries.name: Teagan
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Teagan is a white teacup with a light yellow base, scalloped edge, and body. She has golden eyeshadow and droopy, black eyes with two eyelashes on the bottom. She wears a long, V-necked dress the same shade as her eyeshadow with three tiny, light gold stars in the top right, bottom right, bottom left, and back of the dress. She wears two golden gloves and holds a fluffy white boa shawl around her neck. She has sweet tea inside of her head (confirmed in her dialogue with  Finn) and also has a black bottom lip. Personality Teagan is a kind and elegant Toon who likes to invite the other Toons to her tea gatherings. She knows how to make the teas suitable for the other Toons, and has memorized their favorite kinds of tea, which is stated in their introduction card and proven by their interactions. She is also calm and composed, and they seem to like to keep etiquette, based on her interaction with  Rodger, where they say they make sure no Ichor gets on her boa.

entries.name: Tisha
entries.content:
Side character
Appearance
Tisha is a cyan tissue box that wears a dark blue bell-shaped dress with a light blue, rounded trim on the hem. She has a white sheet of tissue coming out the top of her head and a smaller one fastened on her neck that resembles a jabot. She often hold her hands behind her back when idling or running. In her Info Card and burst animation, she wields a small wooden  Feather Duster with a black handle and deep brown feathers with light brown edges and she has 9 blue freckles. Personality Tisha is a Toon who loves cleaning, and dislikes anything that's deemed messy and/or disorganized - so much so that she can sometimes come off as obsessed. This can be backed up as evidenced by her interaction with  Boxten: "shining, sparkling, so clean you'll need a wet floor sign". She possibly cleans too much and overworks herself, as implied in her interaction with  Astro and with  Razzle & Dazzle. Despite her love of cleaning, she takes great offense and often gets quite frustrated with people not respecting the work she does, to the point where she'd either refuse cleaning requests (as shown in her interaction with  Sprout), or outright show a dislike towards toons that she deems to not appreciate her work enough, as shown in her interactions with  Vee. However, she does shows a more friendly side of herself to  Shelly, as Tisha helping her clean fossils shows us she is more than just her fixation and will support the ones she cares about when needed.

entries.name: Yatta
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Yatta is a piñata with a vibrant color palette. She has two piñata points on her head that stick straight up and resembles horns, with strands of ribbons consisting of sky-blue and bright yellow. Her face is mostly covered in sky-blue and bright yellow, with a smaller dash of pink in the middle of her face, with a circular form resembling the letter m. A simple, toothy grin with three teeth stretches across her face. Her arms are mostly bright yellow, with 2 pink and sky-blue stripes forming two bracelet-like markings residing near her hands; Yatta's legs have a similar pattern. Her body contains colorful stripes of pink, sky-blue, and bright yellow, reminiscent of the traditional paper fringe of a piñata. She has four long tails, which are a slightly darker pink, flat, and the 2 upper tails are slightly longer than the lower two. Personality Yatta is a crazy, generous, hyper, and loud Toon, always putting her friends in a positive light and thinking "highly" of them. As seen in conversations with  Astro and  Teagan, Yatta is jittery and hates keeping still on top of being somewhat impatient, which is shown in one of her interactions with  Connie. She also doesn't fall easily for tricks, as seen in  Gigi's dialogue with her. Additionally, Yatta is more attentive and cleverer than she initially appears, managing to pick up on an interest  Shelly has (outside of dinosaurs) from  Tisha and bringing it up to her, or managing to turn one of  Shrimpo's insults back on him. However, her behavior can make other Toons concerned for her. Yatta is obsessed with candy; it is quite likely that she eats candy excessively, based on her interactions with  Sprout. She also seems to come off as highly ignorant- at least of some social conventions- as some Toons show dislike on how she suddenly pops up in conversations without warning or occasionally scares them with her habit of crawling around in Gardenview's vent system.

entries.name: Connie
entries.content:
full name Connie Boolynski or just Miss. Boolynski side character 
Appearance
Connie is a light-blue ghost with a white visor and long hair that is a darker shade from her body. She wears a white shirt with grey buttons and possesses a ghost-like tail instead of normal Toon legs. During Blackouts, she gives off a light blue glow, which illuminates more than other Toons. Personality Connie is a charismatic, mischievous, and snarky ghost who has a tendency to lie about her. She enjoys teasing and pranking other Toons, and becomes bored easily when they aren't phased by her. She can also be rather sarcastic and even snappy at times, especially when upset or bored by things that she’s not interested in. Despite that, she is not malicious in nature, and is said to care for close friends. Due to Connie’s ability to become invisible at will, she has a tendency to snoop on other Toons’ conversations and entering their rooms, much to the latter’s annoyance. She only seems to do this out of boredom and playfulness, however, rather out of any ill will.

entries.name: Choca
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance
Cocoa is a light brown colored chocolate bunny, with a brown heart-shaped nose, and brown cheeks, as well as 2 sets of 2 eyelashes underneath her eyes and a darker brown drizzle of chocolate between her eyes. Her ears are long, droopy, and dark on the inside, and are tied together by a white scrunchie. She has a white tail and white fluff around her neck, which seems to be made of whipped cream. And also having a darker shade of brown colored onto her paws. Personality Cocoa is a kind and jolly Toon who is always trying to be helpful. She believes that even the "meanest" of Toons need help at times, even if they don't ask for it. As shown in an interaction with  Eggson, she is always overworking herself to help others. She sometimes is even seen pushing help on others before finally backing off as seen in a few interactions. She seems to be persistent in what she believes in. In Cocoa's dialogues with  Bassie, she is still seen viewing her as her friend, likely not knowing about Bassie's resentment towards her.

entries.name: Eggson
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance:Eggson is a halved brown egg. The white and yolk of the egg are visible, and he sports a small pair of glasses and a gentle smile. He wears a pinstriped buttoned shirt that is colored orange and yellow around the torso, white on the sleeves, and yellow on the cuffs. He also wields an orange cane, which has a yellow stripe on it.
Personality:Eggson is portrayed to behave elderly. He typically has his mind on eggs, as seen in various dialogues mentioning "eggs". He has a lot of wisdom and knowledge, considering that he is an elder. He also gives advice and short stories to Toons who he feels may need it to calm themselves down so they can feel better.

entries.name: Flyte
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance:Flyte is a tall, cyan butterfly. He has an upside-down teardrop shaped head and cyan legs. Atop his head, he has two antennae that end in dark cyan clovers. He wears pink makeup under his eyelids and a long, dark cyan cloak the same color as his antennae. He sports pink fluff around his neck, and pastel pink wings. Each wing has clover markings of a darker shade of pink on them. He has no visible arms or mouth.
Personality:Flyte is portrayed as a caring and friendly toon, though he most likely has a fathomless facade behind him. As seen in some dialogues, he frequently checks up on other Toons to make sure they are okay. He is implied to be somewhat indolent and laid-back in some of his dialogues, bickering with  Flutter about how much he flies compared to her. He seems to care very much for his little sister Flutter and fusses over her at times, much to her annoyance.

entries.name: Coal
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance:Coal is a dark gray dog-like rock the shape and size of a boulder, with four dark, stubby legs, a similarly rock-like tail and black snowflake marks on her cheeks. She has a bored, tired, somewhat cross expression on her face, having dark circles under her eyes and thick, furrowed brows. She wears a red two-sided satchel over her back with a flag on it, the flag having a similar crossbone design to the marks on her face.
Personality:Coal is a rather stoic Toon, though she often appears grumpy, frequently growling. She generally isn't excited about many things, as shown in her dialogue with Rudie and information card. Unlike the other Christmas Toons, she doesn't seem to care about the holidays. She's usually well-behaved, as shown in her interaction with  Teagan.

entries.name: Ginger
entries.content:
Side character 
Appearance: Ginger is a light brown cookie with the right side of her face being bitten off. She has reddish-pink eyeshadow with two sets of eyelashes and a pink blush. She has white frosting hair with reddish-pink sprinkles on it. She wears a reddish-pink sleeveless dress with a lighter striped pattern and a white collar as well as mauve and white striped stirrup tights.
Personality: Ginger is a shy Toon as stated in her introduction card. She seems somewhat insecure (as suggested in her dialogue with Bobette), and is slightly timid and socially awkward. However, she seems to love baking as much as  Sprout and  Cosmo do, and cares for her cousin (Cosmo), despite being unable to always be there for him and the other Toons, as she is a holiday Toon. She also tries to look for entertainment to keep her busy outside of the holidays, proven in her interaction with  Vee.

entries.name: Rudie
entries.content:
Appearance: Rudie is an anthropomorphic brown reindeer with unguligrade legs and a large, red nose. He has lighter patches of brown on his face, insides of his ears and on his torso. His hooves, spots and neck fur are dark brown, and he has red and white candy cane-like antlers on the top of his head. During Blackouts, his nose glows red.
Personality: Rudie is a cheerful and friendly Toon who has a passion for the holidays and seems to believe that it is Christmas every day. He has a very jolly and happy personality, and is always in a festive spirit.

entries.name: Ichor
entries.content: This may suggest that Ichor is the Toons' blood, which is further supported by the fact that Toons burst into a dark, Ichor-like substance upon death.Ichor in a liquid state feels slimy and gross, and in a solid state it feels jello-like.

entries.name: Blot
entries.content:
Appearance
Blot is a gray ink blob with a teardrop-shaped head, dripping on the right side, his face, and neck. He wears mime makeup, with darker gray cheeks, a black-and-white striped shirt, white gloves, and legs that fade into black, appearing to melt into the ground.
Personality Blot is a friendly, silly Toon who often checks in on others and shows concern when they're upset, like with Boxten. He enjoys pantomime, as seen in his info card and interactions with Looey. Despite his upbeat demeanor, he has a more serious, possibly overworked side. He dislikes extractions and descending floors, and hints suggest he's the leader of the circus troupe. He keeps a watchful eye on Looey and Yatta and often scolds Yatta for her messes and antics, though he still cares deeply for them. Blot turns down Vee’s offer to work with her, but happily performs with his troupe in her shows—showing his loyalty and love for his friends. He only speaks in backward English but fully understands normal speech.
